# FDN Hare Apparent: "When this creature enters, create a number of 1/1 white Rabbit creature
# tokens equal to the number of other creatures you control named Hare Apparent. A deck can have
# any number of cards named Hare Apparent."
# Enters: CREATE_TOKEN of a 1/1 white Rabbit (M20 Raise the Alarm's token shape) whose count is
# M21 Rin and Seri's verified "the number of Cats you control" QCount (ALL over the battlefield)
# with M21 Frantic Inventory's verified NAME_EQ for "named Hare Apparent", your creatures other
# than this one (FNot(IS_SOURCE), "other"). The count is read as the trigger resolves.
# The deck rule has no tree: the label "deck rule" (MAPPER_GUIDE, Labelled sentences).
etb = TriggeredAbility(
    event=ZoneChangeEvent(
        from_zone=Zone(kind=ZoneKind.ANY, controller=ControllerRef.ANY),
        to_zone=Zone(kind=ZoneKind.BATTLEFIELD, controller=ControllerRef.YOU),
        subject=FAtom(pred=FAtomPred.IS_SOURCE),
    ),
    condition=None,
    effect=A(Verb.CREATE_TOKEN, {
        'count': QCount(
            selector=Selector(
                count=QUnbounded(),
                mode=SelectorMode.ALL,
                filter=FAnd(
                    children=(
                        FAtom(pred=FAtomPred.CONTROLLER_IS, who=ControllerRef.YOU),
                        FAtom(pred=FAtomPred.NAME_EQ, string_value='Hare Apparent'),
                        FAtom(pred=FAtomPred.TYPE_EQ, string_value='Creature'),
                        FNot(inner=FAtom(pred=FAtomPred.IS_SOURCE)),
                    ),
                ),
                zones=(Zone(kind=ZoneKind.BATTLEFIELD, controller=ControllerRef.ANY),),
            ),
        ),
        'tokens': TokenSpec(
            name='Rabbit',
            type_line='Creature — Rabbit',
            types=('Creature',),
            subtypes=('Rabbit',),
            power=QConst(value=1),
            toughness=QConst(value=1),
            keywords=(),
            abilities=(),
            colors=('W',),
        ),
    }),
)
abilities = [etb, *compiled]
